svg.text: 10 switches, 20 hosts, RYU controller, all inter-switch links 10 Mbps / 2 ms delay (OpenFlow 1.3), QoS queues on s1-eth3
video (1): h1 — VIP video sender, Priority Queue 0 on s1-eth3
download (1): h2 — bulk downloader, HTB Queue 1 (0.5–10 Mbps)
s1-eth3 ⇄ s2-eth3 : 10 Mbps, 2 ms (bottleneck, QoS queues)
s_k-eth4 ⇄ s_(k+1)-eth3 for k = 2…9 : 10 Mbps, 2 ms each
Critical flow: h1 → h3 via s1-eth3 → s2
1. Critical video flow h1 ↔ h3 can never be disabled
2. At least one of h3/h4 must reach database h5
3. Queue sanity: s1-eth3 bandwidth within 0.5–10 Mbps
Unsafe intents are rejected before reaching the network
